items.text: Understood the six pillars of AWS Well-Architected Framework (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, Sustainability)
Can explain the six perspectives of Cloud Adoption Framework (Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security, Operations)
Know the difference between WAF (technical correctness after migration) and CAF (organizational readiness before migration)
Understood core security principle: controlling access at two stages (before and after reaching system)
Can explain network hardening vs system hardening with real-life analogies
Know why organizations fail in cloud migration (poor planning and design, not technology)
Can use AWS Well-Architected Tool to review workloads and identify risks
Know how to create Security Groups with least privilege rules (web, app, database tiers)
Can configure Network ACLs for subnet-level protection
Know how to create IAM users and roles with minimal permissions
Can enable and configure automated patching with Systems Manager
Know how to enable CloudTrail and VPC Flow Logs for security monitoring
Can harden Linux servers (disable root, set file permissions, stop unused services)
Know how to separate VPC into public/private subnets for network segmentation
Can name all six WAF pillars and explain purpose of each in interview
Can name all six CAF perspectives and common roles for each
Know exam topics: 1-2 questions on WAF pillars, 1-2 on CAF perspectives, security hardening concepts
Understand real-world scenarios: when to use Security Groups vs NACLs, IAM roles vs access keys
